additional_info.subject: ID0484159-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002645] pluglock and power delivery issue CRM:02681001632
additional_info.body:
Dear
Manuela
,
Following your request and after our check, we can confirm that at the timestamp you mentioned, no charge session had started. The failure could be related to
AUTHENTICATION
or
PARAMETER_DISCOVERY
.
Also, when the cable is locked in the car, this is an
EV-side issue
, not the charger’s. The charger does not have a system to lock the cable; some EVs have a special button to release the cable.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
